title: Investigate S4 dGPU re-enumeration and boot stall
description: Two generation-465 hibernate attempts from settled hybrid-igpu-only aborted back into the running kernel instead of powering off. During the S4 return, firmware reported the NVIDIA root-port slot present/link-up, re-enumerated VGA/audio, and loaded NVIDIA DRM into the existing AMD-only Wayland session. The desktop became unusable and required forced shutdown. The first subsequent boot attempt visibly stalled at GRUB or kernel text before persistent journaling; the second boot succeeded and early reconciliation detached NVIDIA. Investigate without repeating S4 until evidence capture and recovery are fail-safe.
acceptance_criteria: The failing S4 phase and wake source are identified with persisted evidence; detached hibernation cannot reattach NVIDIA into a thawed graphical session; aborted hibernate restores or reconciles topology before user processes thaw; recovery does not require forced power removal; any test distinguishes general platform-hibernate failure from iGPU-only behavior and has an explicit rollback; successful boot behavior remains unchanged.
notes: Read-only ACPI analysis identifies the platform-S4 trigger. DSDT GPP0._PRW advertises GPE 0x08 for S4 wake when WKPM=1, matching enabled /proc/acpi/wakeup node pci:0000:00:01.1. Global _PTS handles Arg0=4 by calling DGHP(One). DGHP sets dGPU-present state, invokes GPP0.PG00._ON, waits 100ms, and notifies PEGP with a bus check. PG00._ON performs physical dGPU power-on and waits for NVIDIA vendor 0x10de. Linux acpi_hibernation_ops.pre_snapshot executes this ACPI preparation before create_image() checks pm_wakeup_pending(). Both failures then log GPP0 Card present, Link Up, and spurious PME with no competing S4 wake-device event. The exact wakeup-source object/IRQ was not printed because pm_debug_messages=0, but firmware-induced GPP0 hotplug is established as the rollback trigger. First workaround candidate: systemd HibernateMode=shutdown, which bypasses platform pre-snapshot callbacks and _PTS(4); unvalidated. Do not disable GPP0 wake first because firmware would still power on the dGPU during frozen topology. Do not retry platform mode. Any shutdown-mode test must first enable pm_debug_messages and pm_print_times and prepare immediate root capture of wakeup_sources, pm_wakeup_irq, graphics topology, and journal if it returns.

title: Validate hibernate in iGPU-only mode
description: Validate hibernate and resume while generation 465 is settled in hybrid-igpu-only. Capture boot ID, graphics status, PCI/DRM topology, root-port power state, session state, failed units, and relevant kernel journal before hibernation and after resume. Treat a cold boot instead of resume as a failed validation and preserve safe recovery.
acceptance_criteria: The machine writes a hibernation image, powers down, resumes the same boot/session, retains selected hybrid-igpu-only policy with detached and settled NVIDIA topology, keeps the internal eDP panel functional, has no new failed units or NVIDIA/Legion kernel errors, and records evidence sufficient to distinguish resume from cold boot.
notes: Preflight on 2026-09-02: login1 CanHibernate=yes; /sys/power/state includes disk and /sys/power/disk selected platform; 32 GiB swapfile active and unused for 32 GiB RAM; Plasma Wayland on eDP-2; selected/expected/effective hybrid-igpu-only/detached/detached and settled; NVIDIA PCI functions absent; root port 0000:00:01.1 runtime-suspended in D3cold; zero failed units. FAILED twice in boots 1b5154c8 and bc895c16. Both rolled back during S4 snapshot preparation before image creation or final platform power-down, immediately re-enumerated NVIDIA VGA/audio, and returned after 12.647s and 9.786s. The second attempt captured KWin DRM-lessee/output/EGL/card0 failures before the display became unusable. Both required forced shutdown; the first subsequent boot attempt after each failure stalled at GRUB or kernel text before journald, while the second boot succeeded. Current boot 76d2cb91 recovered detached before SDDM with zero failed units and no pstore record. Read-only firmware analysis establishes the trigger: platform S4 executes _PTS(4), which calls DGHP(One); DGHP powers GPP0.PG00 on, waits 100ms, and sends a PEGP bus check. Linux then logs GPP0 Card present, Link Up, and PME before create_image() takes the pre-image wake rollback. Do not retry platform mode. HibernateMode=shutdown is the first unvalidated workaround candidate because it bypasses ACPI platform pre-snapshot callbacks; any test requires hibernate-specific diagnostics and explicit recovery preparation.

title: Validate external displays in iGPU-only mode
description: Validate every available physical HDMI, USB-C DisplayPort, and DisplayPort output while generation 465 is settled in hybrid-igpu-only. Record DRM connector changes, KScreen behavior, internal-panel survival, NVIDIA PCI topology, root-port power state, kernel warnings, and recovery after unplugging. Do not change graphics policy or force device operations during the detached checks.
acceptance_criteria: Each physically available external output is tested and mapped to its DRM connector; expected working or unavailable behavior is documented; the internal eDP panel and Wayland session remain functional; no NVIDIA PCI function unexpectedly re-enumerates; graphics status remains detached and settled; failures include safe recovery guidance.
notes: Generation-465 detached baseline captured on 2026-09-02: active Wayland session on internal card2-eDP-2 at 3200x2000@165; card2-DP-2 through DP-9 all disconnected; selected/expected/effective state is hybrid-igpu-only/detached/detached and settled; NVIDIA PCI functions are absent; root port 0000:00:01.1 is runtime-suspended in D3cold; zero failed units. Physical port checks are blocked because no external monitor is currently available.

title: Confirm final NotifyDGPUStatus semantics
description: Reconciliation writes notify_dgpu=true while NVIDIA is attached, then returns immediately when the next observation is detached. It does not write notify_dgpu=false after an in-loop detach; false is written only when reconciliation begins already detached. Confirm from the firmware method and Lenovo reference behavior whether the observed final absence must be reported before poweroff, and whether the current one-way notification leaves stale firmware state.
acceptance_criteria: Firmware/reference semantics are documented; tests assert the correct notification sequence for attached-to-detached, already-detached, detached-to-attached, timeout, and blocked cases; implementation changes only if evidence establishes the required final notification; live validation confirms settled topology and clean rollback.
close_reason: Firmware semantics documented; reconciliation now reports final observed availability with transition, final-attempt, timeout, and blocked coverage.

title: Verify all NVIDIA PCI functions during detach
description: GraphicsTopology currently determines effective attachment from NVIDIA display-class PCI functions only. Hybrid iGPU-only can therefore report settled/detached without proving that sibling NVIDIA audio, USB, UCSI, or other functions and their drivers have disappeared. The 2026-09-01 hardware transition removed VGA and audio, but the poweroff stall makes complete function-level evidence necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Status reports partial or needed rather than detached while any NVIDIA PCI function expected to eject remains present or driver-bound; ejection preflight accounts for relevant sibling device clients such as NVIDIA HDMI audio; tests cover display-absent/audio-present and other partial topologies; existing complete detach and Hybrid attachment behavior remains valid.
close_reason: Topology now verifies every NVIDIA PCI function and preflight includes HDMI-audio nodes; focused and CLI tests pass.

title: Fix legion WMI notify lifetime guard
description: The legion_wmi_notify callback reads legion_shared under legion_shared_mutex but uses if ((!priv) && (priv->loaded)), which dereferences priv when NULL and does not reject priv->loaded == false. After the unlock path it sleeps and calls legion_platform_profile_notify(priv->ppdev), so a late WMI event during probe/remove can dereference stale or NULL shared state. Fix callback lifetime handling without holding the shared mutex across the 500ms delay, and determine whether the unconditional delayed profile notification is still required.
acceptance_criteria: The callback returns safely when shared state is absent or unloading; no priv dereference occurs after its protected lifetime ends; WMI unregister/remove ordering prevents a concurrent stale callback; focused build/static checks pass; behavior is validated with event/remove race coverage where feasible.
close_reason: Fixed callback lifetime guard; revalidates shared state after delay and kernel 7.2.2 build/checkpatch pass.

title: Investigate poweroff stall after live dGPU detach
description: After a guarded Hybrid to hybrid-igpu-only live detach on 2026-09-01, systemctl poweroff completed normal userspace teardown in about 2 seconds: Docker stopped, sessions ended, swap deactivated, filesystems unmounted, and systemd reached System Power Off. systemd-shutdown then logged 'Syncing filesystems and block devices' and 'Sending SIGTERM to remaining processes' but did not visibly progress, so power was forced off. The next generation-464 cold boot was healthy with no EXT4 recovery, I/O errors, or failed units. Investigate which remaining process or kernel task prevents final poweroff after dGPU removal. Do not force-repeat until process/task evidence can be captured safely.
notes:
Backend hardening pushed as LenovoLegionLinux dec598335b9482c4b63ff02f34c1bc26d1d6cabc: WMI callback lifetime revalidation, all-function NVIDIA topology, HDMI-audio client preflight, and final NotifyDGPUStatus reporting. Quality gates pass (34 pytest, scoped pylint 10/10, Black, CLI smoke, checkpatch, Nix app and kernel 7.2.2 module builds). NixOS pin dc7584f and diagnostics 3a74080 are pushed. Generation 465 boot verification passed on 2026-09-02: running closure ckq4v5qn0djmyj01h9kq16qw5h333i0z, hardened module vfhk7n9 and CLI 7djhy3, early root reconciliation exited 0 with selected Hybrid and expected/effective attached, settled in one attempt with complete client inspection. Both NVIDIA VGA/audio functions are bound; nvidia-smi is healthy; Legion control, telemetry, display manager, and reconciler are active; zero failed units. Runtime status correctly identifies wireplumber on NVIDIA /dev/snd/controlC0 as well as Xwayland/Code graphics clients. The AMD power_psr.c:659 warning is identical to generation 464 and not a backend regression. Remaining: controlled guarded detach and instrumented poweroff validation.
Generation-465 instrumented detached poweroff passed on 2026-09-02. Root graphics status before arming was settled hybrid-igpu-only with expected/effective detached, complete client inspection, and zero clients. Pre-poweroff and final-target snapshots both showed the NVIDIA root port runtime-suspended in D3cold with no NVIDIA PCI functions. The final-target capture at 08:20:31.956 had zero failed units, no active swaps or process locks, and no persistent uninterruptible tasks. ps briefly sampled kworker/3:3+events in D at synchronize_rcu_normal, but the subsequent per-task scan was empty and shutdown completed immediately, so this was transient rather than the original stall. Userspace reached systemd-shutdown at 08:20:32 and the machine powered off normally. The next boot started cleanly at 08:21:36 with no filesystem recovery, I/O errors, failed units, or pstore record; early reconciliation preserved hybrid-igpu-only and settled detached after six attempts. The original one-off stall did not reproduce after backend dec5983 hardening and complete display/audio quiescing; its precise cause remains unknown. Evidence: /var/log/legion-shutdown-diagnostics/2026-09-02T08-19-28+01-00-detached/.
close_reason: Instrumented detached poweroff completed normally after hardened backend and client quiescing; final-target and next-boot evidence showed no persistent blocker. Original stall remains unconfirmed and should be reopened only with fresh recurrence evidence.

title: Add controlled iGPU-only privileged workflow
description: Add a narrow LegionControl1 graphics-mode contract and a controlled Hybrid iGPU-only workflow that preserves root client inspection, immediate pre-write recheck, authoritative readback, and recovery guidance. Do not add arbitrary root execution, sudo/pkexec fallback, process-force controls, or Hybrid Auto writes.
acceptance_criteria: D-Bus accepts only explicitly safe graphics modes and fixed argv; Hybrid Auto is rejected; operation timeout covers backend reconciliation; backend exit 2 maps to blocked-before-write and exit 3 maps to selected-but-unsettled; Dart preserves typed errors through the bridge and reloads authoritative status after writes; UI never optimistically claims success and requires the documented session-stopped workflow; native, client, repository, BLoC, and widget tests pass.
notes:
Live detach is proven safe only after display-manager, graphical-session targets, Wayland/X11 sessions, and detached Electron clients are stopped. Root /proc fd inspection remains the sole safety gate. Depends on early-boot reconciliation.
Implemented the guarded typed control path. LegionControl1 exposes SetGraphicsMode with a three-mode allow-list (Hybrid, Hybrid iGPU-only, Discrete), fixed argv, 35-second timeout, and distinct GraphicsBlocked/GraphicsPending errors; Hybrid Auto is rejected. Dart preserves classifications through the bridge, uses a 45-second repository timeout, requires strict authoritative post-write readback, and presents confirmed non-Auto controls with consequence-specific recovery dialogs. Native, client, repository, BLoC, widget, analyzer, and UI detector gates pass. Hardware UI validation remains blocked on lllf-j9t.1 deployment.
Boot dependency lllf-j9t.1 closed after generation-464 hardware validation, including persisted iGPU-only cold boot and blocked/timeout fail-closed behavior. Guarded D-Bus/UI hardware validation is now unblocked. Plasma session teardown must stop graphical-session.target/plasma-workspace-wayland.target and terminate Wayland/X11 sessions before SDDM restart; timeout probe recovery helper is frontend 0b6638f.
Hardware UI validation completed on generation 464 in settled Hybrid with Code and Xwayland retaining dGPU/DRM device clients. The Flutter confirmation flow authorized through the persistent LegionControl1 connection, SetGraphicsMode(hybrid-igpu-only) returned typed GraphicsBlocked, and the UI presented consequence-specific recovery guidance. Authoritative post-action readback remained selected_mode=hybrid, expected/effective dGPU attached, reconciliation=settled; zero failed units. Quality gates: exact-checkout Nix native package build/ctest passed, 69 focused Flutter tests passed, flutter analyze clean, Linux debug build passed.

title: Show authoritative combined graphics status
description: Replace the frontend's legacy binary Hybrid/G-Sync model with read-only combined graphics status from the hardened backend. Show selected policy separately from expected/effective dGPU topology and reconciliation, keep status visible when NVIDIA is detached, and truthfully warn when Auto was selected externally.
acceptance_criteria: Flutter parses all documented status tokens fail-closed; dGPU page remains available with detached NVIDIA; selected, expected, effective, reconciliation, and advertised choices are distinct; Auto is visible but non-actionable with safety guidance; no compute-process list is used as a detach gate; existing legacy Hybrid write UI is removed or disabled; repository, BLoC, parser, and widget tests pass on desktop layouts.
notes:

Implemented read-only authoritative combined graphics status. Added strict schema/token parsing for selected policy, expected/effective topology, reconciliation, advertised modes, client-inspection completeness, clients, and attempts; malformed/unsupported status fails closed without erasing other GPU telemetry. The dGPU page now keeps graphics state visible when NVIDIA is detached, separates policy/topology/reconciliation, warns when Auto was selected externally, and removes the legacy binary Hybrid write UI. Added parser, repository, state, BLoC, detached/Auto, compact-width widget coverage. 45 dGPU tests and full 504-test Flutter suite pass; flutter analyze is clean; Impeccable detector reports no findings. Current installed NixOS legion_cli predates --json, so live status remains unavailable until the validated backend generation is deployed; no legacy fallback is used.

Do not unload modules, execute arbitrary commands, or depend on a desktop session.
acceptance_criteria: A NixOS oneshot runs after required modules/sysfs and before display-manager.service; Hybrid/Discrete settle without disruption; persisted Hybrid iGPU-only is reconciled with complete root inspection before graphical clients can open NVIDIA; unknown, blocked, partial, and timeout states fail closed with useful journal evidence; systemd ordering, Nix build, reboot, and cold-boot behavior are tested on hardware.
notes:
Discovered after the 2026-08-31 reboot retained igpumode=1 but NVIDIA enumerated and bound before legion_laptop loaded. Backend contract is LenovoLegionLinux 78f33ee; reconciliation can take up to 25 seconds.
Implemented opt-in services.legionControl.reconcileGraphicsAtBoot orchestration: legion_laptop is loaded through boot.kernelModules and a fixed root oneshot runs graphics-mode reconcile --json after modules/local filesystems and before/required by display-manager.service with a 40-second timeout. Nix parsing, nixfmt, full module evaluation, command, kernel-module, and ordering assertions pass. Hardware deployment, reboot, blocked/timeout journal behavior, and cold-boot validation remain pending.

title: Replace per-command pkexec with privileged D-Bus control
description: Add a dedicated root LegionControl1 system-bus service with session-scoped Polkit authorization, a typed allow-listed hardware/service API, and a Flutter client that replaces repeated pkexec legion_cli and pkexec systemctl launches. Keep LegionTelemetry1 read-only and separately sandboxed.
acceptance_criteria: The first privileged frontend action authenticates once through Polkit; subsequent allowed actions on the same D-Bus connection do not reprompt; authorization is revoked on disconnect; arbitrary commands, paths, units, and unsupported values are rejected; telemetry remains read-only; backend, Flutter, service, and NixOS tests/builds pass.
notes:
Implemented LegionControl1 root system-bus service, sender-scoped Polkit authorization, strict typed allow-lists, bounded payload/output handling, timeout/disconnect cleanup, Flutter D-Bus client migration with no pkexec fallback, NixOS/systemd/D-Bus/Polkit packaging, diagnostics/recovery copy, and fail-closed UI for unsupported mutations. Verified 493 Flutter tests, flutter analyze, Linux release build, Nix service package CTest/build, and standalone NixOS module evaluation. Runtime Polkit prompt reuse and disconnect revocation still require deployment from a privileged shell.
Deployment configuration committed and pushed in nixos-flaky-tests at 4ed6366, pinning frontend 479aeb5 and backend c539a86 and enabling services.legionControl. Full dirty-tree NixOS toplevel build passed. Installation remains blocked in this execution environment because sudo is denied by no_new_privileges; keep issue in_progress until live Polkit prompt reuse/disconnect revocation are verified.
Live test confirmed one Polkit authorization prompt, but legion_cli failed because the NixOS system service PATH omitted bash. Fix adds immutable bashNonInteractive, e2fsprogs, and util-linux paths; NixOS supplies baseline coreutils/grep/systemd paths. Standalone module evaluation asserts all added runtime packages and the service package build passes.
Live Custom-mode control now succeeds through LegionControl1 and platform_profile reads custom. Runtime logs exposed one sandbox interaction: legion_cli's eager dmesg read hit the denied syslog syscall and created a root coredump. Backend eb984e8 now skips that diagnostic unless INFO logging is enabled and captures diagnostic stderr; frontend 5d28c5c sets SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM while retaining ProtectKernelLogs=true. The pinned backend/service packages rebuilt successfully, 2/2 CTest targets passed, and generated NixOS service evaluation reports EPERM. Same-connection prompt reuse and post-reconnect reauthorization remain the final interactive checks.
Suspend/resume runtime validation found a stale client authorization cache: the service had revoked the sender while the Flutter client retained its completed authorization future, so the first post-resume write failed with AccessDenied: Authorize must be called first. Frontend 7d38a31 now treats method-level authorization loss as pre-execution cache invalidation, performs one shared interactive Authorize, and retries the original typed method exactly once. Polkit denial/cancellation during Authorize still fails immediately. Regression test, 493-test full suite, flutter analyze, and Linux release build pass. Live post-resume verification remains pending after restarting the frontend on this revision.
Final live acceptance passed on frontend 7d38a31: after restarting the Flutter client, privileged Polkit authorization worked and setting Custom after sleep/resume succeeded without Authorize must be called first. This confirms transparent reauthorization and retry after service-side sender-cache loss.

The VGA function remained present and unbound, NVIDIA audio disappeared, nvidia-smi reported no device, and live Hybrid rollback restored firmware readback but did not rebind PCI drivers. Current combined status is insufficient if it reports selector only.

title: Deploy Kernel 7 Legion fan driver
description: Replace the active pre-Kernel-7 LenovoLegionLinux read_file_fix pin with a tested immutable revision containing upstream PRs #423 and #434, rebuild and reboot NixOS, then verify the synthetic legion platform device and legion_hwmon on Lenovo 82Y4 / M1CN48WW. acceptance_criteria: NixOS source pin contains upstream merges 1570dba2c8c3079115439f43e50d2891813c38d9 and c52b4f293c4e8c00acf6bfba2bbd06b862cdf4a1; rebuilt generation boots; PNP0C09 remains owned by acpi-ec; synthetic platform:legion/legion binds; kernel logs show successful probe; legion_hwmon exposes truthful fan limits and curve points; frontend reads the real curve; results are recorded without unsafe live EC rebinding.
notes:
Phase 0 read-only /dev/mem capture decoded (2026-08-30, balanced, AC): DFAN+0xF0 power limits are live and match DSDT defaults exactly; the DFAN curve area and step indices are all zero on a clean boot, and F10A==0 means GFAN returns the ACPI CFST package initializer (1..8,8,8) verbatim - the exported curve is a DSDT constant, not hardware state. Revised fix: compose the curve from the A7/SFTW per-mode FACT tables (RPM palette + CPU temps + max speeds) plus step indices; writes via Fan_Set_Table (mode + ten step indices), then verify the populated DFAN registers read-only as the round-trip check. Updated plan and evidence in docs/architecture/legion-driver-issues-handoff.md.
Phase 1 built 2026-08-30: driver main bafa1f3 restores kernel_module exactly from deployed Kernel-7 upstream 3893e20 and retires read_file_fix; f4849cd selects M1CN ACCESS_METHOD_WMI3 power limits, probes/hides unsupported and legacy-only WMI3 fields, gates writes to Custom mode, and demotes legacy raw-value polling to pr_debug. NixOS toplevel build succeeded; module store path 79yjssydl0q1hfs4v9ggkfrsk7lmk9fl has vermagic 7.2.0 and contains the new rejection path. Boot validation pending. Global NO_ACCESS hiding was not used because many older models rely on that historical legacy fallback.

description: Implement Phase 6b. Redesign Automation in the handoff rule-builder vocabulary without losing existing actions. Merge About and core Diagnostics into Settings, retain Boot Logo pending a design decision, and place remaining Devices/Display controls in designed settings groups.
acceptance_criteria: Automation rules represent existing triggers/actions and retain run-now/poll status appropriately; Settings contains Appearance, Backend, About, diagnostics, and retained Boot Logo functionality; Win Key, Camera, Overdrive, and Refresh Rate have explicit homes or tracked design decisions; tests and analyzer pass.

title: Apply Yaru handoff to Battery and dGPU pages
description: Implement Phase 6a. Make Battery and dGPU telemetry-forward, reuse shared metric/history infrastructure, move Always-on USB to Battery with its single write guardrail, and preserve destructive GPU-action warnings and working-mode behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Battery status, health, live usage, controls, and history/export have designed homes; Always-on USB has one canonical implementation on Battery; dGPU identity, P-state, temperature, draw, VRAM, usage, processes, deactivation, and working mode match the handoff where supported; tests and analyzer pass.
notes: Completed Phase 6a Battery and dGPU handoff. Battery now preserves raw charge states, shows health/identity/energy details, records 30-day telemetry history, exports CSV, and owns the single guarded Always-on USB implementation. dGPU now shows persistent PCI identity, NVIDIA P-state/live telemetry, history, process targets, working mode, and guarded deactivation flows with immediate PID/PCI baseline rechecks. Added compact/wide responsive coverage and telemetry/parser/repository safety tests. Quality gates: 464 Flutter tests, flutter analyze, Impeccable detector, and Linux release build. Atomic backend baseline enforcement remains tracked by lllf-cqn.16.
close_reason: Completed Phase 6a Battery/dGPU redesign, telemetry history/export, canonical Always-on USB, guarded GPU actions, and all quality gates.

title: Apply Yaru handoff to Power page
description: Implement Phase 5 of the Yaru handoff plan using LegionAccent and the handoff power/custom-mode screen. Preserve repository and bloc behavior while improving mode selection, descriptions, limits, warnings, and custom tuning hierarchy.
acceptance_criteria: Common mode switching matches the handoff and uses the mode accent; advanced limits are discoverable without visual noise; custom/overclock warnings remain adjacent to controls; responsive light/dark layouts pass; tests and analyzer pass.
notes:

Completed the Yaru Power handoff: responsive semantic mode cards and active-mode descriptions; mode-aware accents; common controller limits as sliders; remaining limits in an advanced disclosure; capability-gated overclock controls with adjacent risk copy; title-bar refresh; Kernel 7 profile aliases; and controller-specific units. close_reason: Completed Phase 5 Power handoff and all quality gates.

title: Implement or track Yaru platform surfaces
description: Implement Phase 7 OSD, StatusNotifierItem/AppIndicator tray, and org.freedesktop.Notifications surfaces. Where native integration cannot land immediately, build the reusable designed widget/event structure and create a concrete integration blocker rather than silently skipping the surface.
